description: An approval bound to both a content hash AND the context in which the approval was given. cwi.context-grant/1.0.

content_ref.description: Human pointer to the content (URL, repo path, manifest location).

approver.description: Identity + authority basis of the approver.

conversation_ref.description: Pointer to the conversation/turn that produced the approval (session id, message ids).

expires_at.description: The approval lease expires here. Any context divergence before this SHOULD trigger re-approval.

model.description: Model id + agent identity that requested/assembled the grant.

tools_available.description: Tool namespaces available to the agent at decision time.

venue.description: Where the approved action executes (repo, chain, platform).

context_hash.description: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of {action, context} — binds content AND context.

prev_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of the previous grant's payload, or GENESIS.

signature.description: Ed25519 (base64) over canonical bytes of the grant payload (everything except signature), signed by the CWI offline key.

title: CWI Context Grant
